data.body: [P2] Revisit the equality conditions under rule 4. The new equality tests compare only parameterized `MapResult` types with null owners; their negative case changes only the item type. Removing either the raw-type comparison or the owner check leaves those assertions unchanged, so these added conditions lack the behavior-distinguishing tests required by “Every branch has a test that fails without it.” The claimed cache-key contract is therefore incompletely guarded. Please return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, and establish which conditions the contract needs and how each will be demonstrated.
